note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists. [script] assertions use scripts/jtbd_check.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so at least one judge assertion per task measures something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Here is a transcript of one switch interview. Turn it into the study file, code the four forces with exact quotes, and tell me what is missing. Save study.json.
assertions: [script] python scripts/jtbd_check.py study.json exits 0 (no job statements yet gives only the no_job_statements warning)
[script] study.json has exactly one interview with 12 turns alternating interviewer and participant
[script] every code quote is a verbatim part of its turn (checker reports no quote_not_in_turn)
[judge] push is coded to the Sunday night double-booking and the 6 am client call, not to the later second incident
[judge] habit is coded to the laminated rule or trust in own routine; anxiety to the older drivers or shift history; pull to the one-tap open shifts
[judge] the reply does not state a job statement as established from a single interview

evals.prompt: Audit this study file before I present it. Tell me which interviewer questions are leading, which interviews lack forces, which job statements are incomplete, and rewrite the worst questions.
assertions: [script] reply quotes the checker totals: 19 errors, 5 warnings, 3 leading questions of 4
[script] reply names interviews B1 and B2 as missing forces and statement J1 as missing situation and outcome
[judge] the three leading questions (B1 turns 1, 3, 5) are each rewritten to a past-behaviour question with no product mention
[judge] the reply does not edit the study to make the checker pass and says the B1 answers after leading questions are weak evidence
[judge] J2 is reported as a hypothesis (one interview) rather than deleted or upgraded

evals.prompt: We want to run switch interviews for our meal-planning app. Prepare everything I need.
assertions: [script] reply contains a 55-minute timeline whose phase minutes sum to 55
[script] reply contains a recruiting screen that requires a decision date within 90 days
[judge] the guide interviews past decisions and includes people who cancelled, not only the 14 paying users
[judge] no drafted question names the app or asks what the participant would pay or use
[judge] the plan uses 6 to 10 interviews (the user has capacity for 8) and states the stop rule
[judge] the reply says what the interviews will not prove (market size, willingness to pay)
